(b) THEN ONE Markdown table consistent with the Lock: - [Source Word] | [Morphology] | [Reference Equivalent] | [Contextual Definition] | [Grammatical Role] Source Text: 106 Di quella umile Italia fia salute 107 per cui morì la vergine Cammilla, 108 Eurialo e Turno e Niso di ferute. Reference Translation (provided): Of that humble Italy shall he be the salvation, for which the virgin Camilla died, and Euryalus, Turnus and Nisus of their wounds.

**Interpretation Lock – FIRST**
- **Line 106** – *Di quella umile Italia fia salute* → **Locked Meaning**: There exists a specific Italy, characterized as *humble* (“quella umile Italia”), such that it will become *the salvation* (“fia salute”). - **Line 107** – *per cui morì la vergine Cammilla* → **Locked Meaning**: The virgin Camilla died **because of** that (the salvation of humble Italy). The relative clause “cui … morì” ties the cause of Camilla’s death to the antecedent in line 106. - **Line 108** – *Eurialo e Turno e Niso di ferute* → **Locked Meaning**: The three heroes Eurialo, Turno, and Niso are *wounded* (“di ferute”). The prepositional phrase “di ferute” predicates a state of injury on each of the three proper names.
